cards.card_text: Then Jesus tells them, “Watch out!” and “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.” Now He's talking baker talk, and my mustache just stood straight up.
cards.verse_text: “Watch out!” Jesus told them. “Beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

cards.card_text: Then He gives the warning again: “But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.” And FINALLY, the light comes on for the disciples.
cards.verse_text: How do you not understand that I was not telling you about bread? But beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.” Then they understood that He was not telling them to beware of the leaven used in bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
